title: Taking Away — Learning to Subtract
memory_verse: "Give, and it will be given to you." — Luke 6:38 (NIV)
objective: Students will learn the concept of subtraction as taking away and practice subtracting numbers within 10.
content: Subtraction means taking away. When we share and give to others, we are subtracting from what we have. Jesus tells us that giving is good!
If you have 5 grapes and you eat 2, how many are left? 5 - 2 = 3. The minus sign (-) means 'take away.'
Let's try more: 7 - 3 = 4. 9 - 5 = 4. 6 - 1 = 5. When we subtract, the number gets smaller.
activity: Start with 10 blocks. Take away different amounts and write the subtraction sentence each time. Example: 10 - 3 = 7. Try at least five subtraction problems.
discussion: What does the minus sign mean?
If you had 8 cookies and gave 3 to a friend, how many would you have left?
Why does Jesus say it is good to give?
